author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp Platform SDK External Data Manager
description: Four-file module replacing FileManagerUI: registers with ExternalDataManager mode and includes an IDataSource skeleton + file-upload UI patterns.

app.description: Target application name (required when the solution has more than one application).

manualInstructions.text: Add the new project to your .sln (dotnet sln add path/to/MyDataManager.fsproj).
Add <ProjectReference> + <Import .Client.props> to the target server / client fsprojs.
Register the data manager in the target Server.fs and Client.fs entry points using ExternalDataManager mode.
